notice.en: Public resource directory. These organizations are not listed as FoodRescue Link partners. Contact the provider to confirm current hours and requirements.
notice.zh: 公共援助资源目录。这些机构并非已确认的 FoodRescue Link 合作伙伴。请向服务机构确认当前开放时间和领取要求。
notice.es: Directorio de recursos públicos. Estas organizaciones no figuran como socios de FoodRescue Link. Confirma los horarios y requisitos actuales con cada organización.

access.en: Public directory entry for the school only. Peddie School has not onboarded with FoodRescue Link; participation in food donations has not been confirmed. This campus is not listed as a public food pickup site. Contact the school for institutional inquiries.
access.zh: 此条目仅收录学校公开信息。Peddie School 尚未入驻 FoodRescue Link，参与食物捐赠尚未确认。该校园不是本平台公布的公共食物领取点。机构相关事宜请联系学校。
access.es: Ficha informativa de la escuela. Peddie School aún no se ha incorporado a FoodRescue Link; no se ha confirmado su participación en donaciones de alimentos. Este campus no figura como punto público de recogida de alimentos. Contacta con la escuela para consultas institucionales.

hours.en: Monday, Wednesday and Friday: 9 am–noon. Also 5–7 pm on the first, second and third Wednesday of each month.
hours.zh: 周一、周三、周五上午9点至中午12点；每月第一个、第二个和第三个周三另开放下午5点至7点。
hours.es: Lunes, miércoles y viernes: de 9 a. m. a mediodía. También de 5 a 7 p. m. el primer, segundo y tercer miércoles de cada mes.

access.en: Call before your first visit to ask about registration, eligibility and documents. Walk-in access has not been confirmed.
access.zh: 首次前往前请致电，询问登记、资格和所需材料。尚未确认是否接受直接到访领取。
access.es: Antes de tu primera visita, llama para preguntar sobre el registro, los requisitos y los documentos. No se ha confirmado la atención sin cita.

hours.en: Third Sunday, 1:30–3:30 pm; November and December may be earlier.
hours.zh: 每月第三个周日13:30–15:30；11月、12月可能提前。
hours.es: Tercer domingo, 13:30–15:30; noviembre y diciembre pueden adelantarse.

access.en: No preregistration. Serves Cranbury and surrounding communities; provide name and phone. Call about emergency food between distributions.
access.zh: 无需提前登记；服务Cranbury及周边社区，现场提供姓名与电话。两次发放之间急需食物可致电。
access.es: Sin inscripción previa. Atiende Cranbury y comunidades cercanas; facilita nombre y teléfono. Llama por alimentos de emergencia entre repartos.

resources.name: Plainsboro Food Pantry
resources.address: 641 Plainsboro Road, Plaza Level, Plainsboro, NJ 08536

hours.en: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday 9 am–noon; Thursday 11 am–2:30 pm. Holidays may vary.
hours.es: Martes, miércoles y viernes 9:00–12:00; jueves 11:00–14:30. Festivos sujetos a cambios.

access.en: Income-eligible Plainsboro residents must apply and submit a shopping list. Up to two visits monthly. Phone extension 1711.
access.zh: 面向符合收入资格的Plainsboro居民；需申请并提交购物清单，每月最多两次。电话分机1711。
access.es: Residentes de Plainsboro que cumplan requisitos de ingresos: solicitud y lista de compras obligatorias. Hasta dos visitas al mes. Extensión 1711.

resources.name: Robbinsville Food Pantry
resources.address: 1117 Route 130 at Folsom Way, Robbinsville, NJ 08691

hours.en: Tuesday 9–11 am; Thursday 9–11 am and 2–3 pm.

access.en: Robbinsville Township residents only. Family sign-in required; weekly food bags subject to availability.
access.zh: 仅限Robbinsville Township居民。家庭需签到，每周食物袋视供应情况提供。
access.es: Solo residentes de Robbinsville Township. La familia debe registrarse; bolsas semanales según disponibilidad.

hours.es: Llama para confirmar el horario de recogida.

access.en: Call for a registration appointment. Pantry is in the small steel building behind the Presbyterian church. Confirm current service-area requirements.
access.zh: 请先电话预约登记。食品站在长老会教堂后方小型钢结构建筑内；服务地区要求请致电确认。
access.es: Llama para una cita de inscripción. Está en el pequeño edificio de acero detrás de la iglesia presbiteriana. Confirma el área de servicio.

resources.name: JFS Middlesex — Monroe Pantry
resources.address: 1600 Perrineville Road, Suite 26, Monroe Township, NJ 08831

hours.en: By appointment only; call for collection times.
hours.zh: 仅预约领取，具体时间请致电。
hours.es: Solo con cita; llama para acordar la recogida.

access.en: For Middlesex County residents of all backgrounds; twice monthly or as needed. Monroe office: 609-395-7979. Provider lists Suite 26; confirm before travel.
access.zh: 服务所有背景的Middlesex County居民；每月两次或按需要。Monroe办公室609-395-7979。机构现列Suite 26，出发前请确认。
access.es: Para residentes de Middlesex County de cualquier origen; dos veces al mes o según necesidad. Oficina Monroe: 609-395-7979. Confirma Suite 26 antes de viajar.

resources.name: Monroe Township Food Pantry
resources.address: 12 Halsey Reed Road, Monroe Township, NJ 08831

hours.en: First Wednesday of the month, 9–11 am, for approved applicants.
hours.zh: 每月第一个周三9:00–11:00，仅限申请获批者。
hours.es: Primer miércoles del mes, 9:00–11:00, para solicitantes aprobados.

access.en: Proof of Monroe residency and financial eligibility required. Call ahead for emergency bags, weekdays 8:30 am–4:30 pm. Operated through Senior Services; ask about eligibility.
access.zh: 需证明Monroe居住资格及经济资格。工作日8:30–16:30可先致电询问紧急食物袋；由Senior Services运营，具体资格请确认。
access.es: Se exige acreditar residencia en Monroe y elegibilidad económica. Llama antes por bolsas de emergencia, lunes a viernes 8:30–16:30. Gestionado por Senior Services; consulta requisitos.

hours.en: By appointment only; open two days weekly. Confirm available appointments.
hours.zh: 仅预约领取，每周开放两天；具体日期以预约为准。
hours.es: Solo con cita; abre dos días por semana. Consulta las citas disponibles.

access.en: All backgrounds welcome; basic contact and household details requested. Visit every other week. Phone ext. 237; Spanish ext. 205. This listing is for the fixed pantry, not restricted mobile stops.
access.zh: 欢迎所有背景居民，需基本联系方式与家庭组成信息；每两周可领取一次。电话分机237，西语205。此处为固定食品站，不是限制对象的流动站。
access.es: Abierto a personas de cualquier origen; se solicitan datos básicos de contacto y hogar. Visitas cada dos semanas. Ext. 237; español 205. Esta ficha es del local fijo, no de paradas móviles restringidas.

hours.en: Monday and Wednesday 11 am–4 pm; Tuesday 1–7 pm.

access.en: For Mercer County residents facing food insecurity. Located on the lower level of Nassau Presbyterian Church. Call to confirm first-visit documents and appointment requirements.
access.zh: 面向有食物困难的Mercer County居民，位于Nassau Presbyterian Church下层。首次前往的材料及预约要求请致电确认。
access.es: Para residentes de Mercer County con dificultades alimentarias. En la planta inferior de Nassau Presbyterian Church. Confirma documentos y requisitos de cita antes de la primera visita.

access.en: Serves selected nearby towns including Hightstown and East Windsor. Check the official website for reopening of applications; do not arrive expecting walk-in food pickup. Phone extension 11.
access.zh: 服务包括 Hightstown、East Windsor 在内的指定周边城镇。请查看官网何时恢复申请，不要直接前往等待领取。电话分机11。
access.es: Atiende localidades cercanas, incluidas Hightstown y East Windsor. Consulta la web para saber cuándo se reabren las solicitudes; no acudas esperando recogida sin cita. Extensión 11.

hours.en: Call to confirm current pickup times.
hours.zh: 当前领取时间请致电确认。
hours.es: Llama para confirmar el horario de recogida.

access.en: South Brunswick residents only. Register first by calling extension 7674 or emailing sbfoodpantry@sbtnj.net. Confirm pickup arrangements during registration.
access.zh: 仅限 South Brunswick 居民。请先致电分机7674或发邮件至 sbfoodpantry@sbtnj.net 登记，并确认领取安排。
access.es: Solo residentes de South Brunswick. Inscríbete llamando a la extensión 7674 o escribiendo a sbfoodpantry@sbtnj.net; confirma cómo recoger los alimentos.

resources.name: Bromley Neighborhood Civic Center Food Pantry

hours.en: Tuesday and Thursday: 9:30–11:30 am and 2:30–3:30 pm. Call about additional dates.
hours.es: Martes y jueves: 9:30–11:30 y 14:30–15:30. Consulta fechas adicionales.

access.en: Registration required for eligible Hamilton Township residents. Ask about income and residency documents before visiting.
access.zh: 面向符合资格的 Hamilton Township 居民，需登记。前往前询问收入及居住证明要求。
access.es: Se requiere inscripción para residentes elegibles de Hamilton Township. Consulta la documentación de ingresos y residencia.

resources.name: John O. Wilson Neighborhood Center Food Pantry

hours.en: Call to confirm current pickup times.
hours.zh: 当前领取时间请致电确认。
hours.es: Llama para confirmar el horario de recogida.

access.en: The township lists a food pantry at this center. Call to confirm eligibility, registration and required documents before visiting.
access.zh: 市政府列明该中心提供食物援助。前往前请电话确认资格、登记及所需材料。
access.es: El municipio incluye una despensa en este centro. Confirma requisitos, inscripción y documentación antes de acudir.

hours.en: Selected Saturdays; confirm the current distribution calendar.
hours.zh: 指定周六发放，具体日期请确认当前日历。
hours.es: Sábados seleccionados; confirma el calendario actual.

access.en: Serves people regardless of religious affiliation. Income eligibility applies according to township information; call to confirm intake requirements.
access.zh: 不限制宗教背景。市政府资料列有收入资格要求，请先致电确认领取条件。
access.es: Atiende sin distinción religiosa. La información municipal indica requisitos de ingresos; confirma las condiciones por teléfono.

access.en: Food assistance for Mercer County neighbors. Call to confirm first-visit requirements. This is the Hudson Street pantry, not the closed 123 East Hanover Street site.
access.zh: 为 Mercer County 居民提供食物援助。首次领取要求请致电确认。此为 Hudson Street 站点，并非已关闭的123 East Hanover Street站点。
access.es: Ayuda alimentaria para vecinos de Mercer County. Confirma requisitos de primera visita. Esta es la despensa de Hudson Street, no el local cerrado de 123 East Hanover Street.

access.en: Rise lists these meals as free, with no questions asked. Confirm the current schedule with Rise before traveling.
access.zh: Rise 官方说明这些热餐免费提供，无需说明情况。出发前请向 Rise 确认当前安排。
access.es: Rise indica que estas comidas son gratis y no se hacen preguntas. Confirma el horario actual con Rise antes de viajar.

locations.name: First United Methodist Church of Hightstown

researchCaveats: The uRise subdomain includes an older contradictory pantry schedule; use the main Rise contact page schedule and advise confirming directly.
Rise appointment page has a general document checklist covering several services. Do not present every listed document as a mandatory pantry-specific requirement.
Older 2024-2025 intake forms conflict with current days and are not a reliable basis for current eligibility or visit frequency.
No provider has been contacted and no partnership, live food inventory, appointment or app reservation is implied.

coverage.en: Around Peddie School in Hightstown and nearby towns. This is a researched selection, not a complete census; service areas vary.
coverage.zh: 以Hightstown的Peddie School及周边城镇为范围。此为已查证的资源选集，并非完整普查；各机构服务范围不同。
coverage.es: En torno a Peddie School, Hightstown y localidades cercanas. Selección investigada, no censo completo; las áreas de servicio varían.
